text: Install the Graphite CLI with Homebrew or npm
quote: Install the Graphite CLI using either Homebrew or npm

text: The CLI breaks large engineering tasks into a series of small, incremental stacked code changes from the command line
quote: The Graphite CLI is a tool to help you break up large engineering tasks into a series of small, incremental code changes directly from the command line.

text: The CLI is fully git-compatible and works on an existing repository using gt commands
quote: The Graphite CLI is fully compatible with git—just install it on an existing repository and begin using our suite of gt commands.

text: Configure the CLI through an interactive menu with gt config
quote: Run gt config to open an interactive menu which lets you configure your Graphite CLI.

text: gt absorb amends staged changes into the relevant commits in the current stack
quote: gt absorb: Amend staged changes to the relevant commits in the current stack.

text: Dry-run mode for absorb shows which commits hunks would go into without applying them
quote: -d, --dry-run Print which commits the hunks would be absorbed into, but do not actually absorb them.

text: Branch names are generated automatically from the commit message when no name is given
quote: If you don't specify a name for your branch when using gt create, then Graphite will generate one for you based on the commit message.

text: Branch naming can be configured with a custom prefix and an optional prepended date
quote: A custom prefix (for example, initials). Whether or not the date is prepended to the branch.

text: Supports multiple Git worktrees without modifying branches checked out in other worktrees
quote: Graphite fully supports multiple Git worktrees. Starting in gt version 1.8.4, Graphite does not modify branches checked out in another worktree in most cases.

text: Edit custom command aliases for the CLI
quote: gt aliases: Edit your command aliases.

text: Optionally auto-delete merged or closed branches during sync and get
quote: Toggle to automatically delete merged or closed branches during gt sync and gt get operations.

text: Automatically include a branch's commit messages in the PR body on submit
quote: Graphite can include the commit messages of your branch in the body of your PR automatically on submit.

text: Restack operations can preserve committer dates using a git rebase flag
quote: The git rebase flag --committer-date-is-author-date is useful if you don't want your Graphite restack operations to update the committer date

text: Authenticate by installing the Graphite GitHub App on your organization
quote: you'll need to authenticate by installing the Graphite App (a GitHub App) on your organization.

text: Enable AI reviews on personal repositories by installing the GitHub App on a personal account
quote: In order to enable AI reviews on your personal repositories, you must first install the Graphite GitHub App on your personal account.

text: AI reviews automatically check pull requests and catch bugs before they ship
quote: AI reviews powered by Graphite Agent help your team build better software by automatically reviewing pull requests and catching bugs before they ship.

text: AI reviews can be turned on in a few clicks with no configuration needed
quote: AI reviews can be enabled in just a few clicks, with no configuration required to start catching bugs in your pull requests.

text: Once enabled, the agent automatically reviews all new pull requests in the selected repositories
quote: Graphite Agent will now automatically review all new pull requests in the selected repositories

text: Enable AI reviews for specific repositories or across the entire organization
quote: You can choose specific repositories or enable AI reviews across your entire organization

text: Codebase-aware AI review agent gives immediate, actionable feedback
quote: Get immediate, actionable feedback with Graphite’s codebase-aware AI code review agent.

text: Define custom rules with explicit guidelines the review agent follows
quote: Custom rules allow you to define explicit guidelines for Graphite Agent to follow when reviewing your code.

text: Comment exclusions specify situations where the review agent should not leave comments
quote: Comment exclusions allow you to specify situations where Graphite Agent should not leave comments.

text: Ask for suggested fixes and apply them in one click from the review page
quote: Ask for suggested fixes and apply them in one click right from the review page.

text: Make direct code changes from the PR page using the Agent panel
quote: Make direct code changes right from your PR page. Click Agent on the right side of the PR to get started.

text: Agent changes are committed directly to the branch and appear in the PR as normal commits
quote: Any changes made by the agent are committed directly to the branch and appear in the PR like any other commit.

text: Diagnose and resolve failing CI checks from the PR page with full CI context
quote: Diagnose and resolve failing checks directly from your PR page with full context from your CI results.

text: Ask Graphite to explain PR changes, highlight potential issues, or give context on specific code
quote: Ask Graphite to explain what changed in a pull request, highlight potential issues, or provide context about specific code sections.

text: Graphite Chat gives context, feedback, and edits from a chat interface inside the review workflow
quote: With Graphite Chat, you can ask for context on code changes, get instant feedback, and make edits directly from the chat interface without leaving your review workflow.

text: Highlight specific diff lines to ask targeted questions about that code
quote: Highlight specific lines in your PR diff to ask targeted questions about that code.

text: Find related files, understand dependencies, and pull context from other PRs without switching tabs
quote: Find related files, understand dependencies, and get context from other PRs without switching tabs.

text: Chat integrates with GitHub so suggestions can be taken in one click
quote: Graphite Chat integrates directly with GitHub where you can take suggestions in 1-click. No context switching needed.

text: Get help understanding and implementing feedback from teammates and reviewers
quote: Get help understanding and implementing feedback from your teammates and reviewers.

text: AI generates pull request titles and descriptions
quote: Generating pull request titles and descriptions

text: Describe work in plain language and Agents pull repo context, generate changes, and open a draft PR
quote: Describe what you want built or fixed in plain language, and Agents will pull context from your repository, generate the changes, and open a draft PR ready for your review.

text: Start a Cloud Agents conversation in Cursor and continue the same agent thread in Graphite
quote: You can start a conversation with Cloud Agents in Cursor, then continue the same agent thread in Graphite.

text: GT MCP lets AI agents automatically split large AI-generated changes into stacked pull requests
quote: GT MCP allows AI agents to automatically create stacked PRs, breaking down large AI-generated changes into smaller, reviewable stacked pull requests.

text: Stack-aware merge queue lands PRs in order and keeps branches green
quote: Our stack-aware merge queue lands PRs in order and keeps branches green, helping you gain momentum.

text: Track PRs across many repos using custom filters and rules
quote: Stay up-to-date with PRs across many repos using custom filters and rules.

text: VS Code extension GUI makes stacking visual from inside the IDE
quote: A GUI designed to make stacking visual and simple, right from your IDE.

text: Insights measures and helps optimize team developer productivity
quote: InsightsMeasure and optimize your team's developer productivity.

text: AI review metrics show issues found, acceptance rates, and PRs reviewed over time
quote: which shows metrics like issues found, acceptance rates, and PRs reviewed over time.

text: Receives GitHub webhooks for real-time CI status, mergeability, and push updates
quote: Receive GitHub webhooks for real-time updates on CI status, mergeability, and push events.

text: AI features are opt-in, and neither Graphite nor its subprocessors train on customer data
quote: AI privacy and security: Graphite's AI features "are opt-in and do not store or train on your data"; "Neither Graphite nor any of its subprocessors use your data to train their models" — with contractual prohibitions on its Anthropic and Op

text: Organizations can request a complete block of all AI features via support
quote: To disable AI features across your entire organization, please email support@graphite.com and request a complete block of all AI features for your organization.

text: Plans include unlimited AI reviews, review customizations, automations, and merge queue
quote:
Unlimited AI Reviews
*   AI Review customizations
*   Automations
*   Merge Queue

text: Slack notifications
quote: Slack notifications
